info.description: MealJi API v1. Folders 'Step 01' to 'Step 17' are the customer app's integration steps, released to the app team one at a time in this order. After them: console sign-in, kitchen console, admin console, settings, uploads, webhooks and health.

item.name: Step 01 · App start
item.description:
Release step 1. Screens: Splash, Onboarding. No sign-in needed.

On launch call App config (force update, maintenance, OTP rules, delivery promise). The first time the app opens, show Onboarding from GET /onboarding/slides. Both are public and cacheable.

request.description:
Public. Call on every launch (Splash).

- `minSupportedVersion` / `forceUpdate`: block old app builds.
- `maintenanceMode` + `maintenanceMessage`: show a maintenance screen.
- `otpLength` (6) and `otpResendSeconds` (30): drive the OTP screen boxes and the resend timer.
- `countryCodes`: only `+91` today.
- `deliveryEtaLabel` (e.g. “25–35 min”), `pickupReadyMinutes` (15), `servedCitiesCount`: the copy on onboarding and home.
- `mealSlotsShown`: which meal slots the app shows.

Admin edits these in Settings → App.

request.description:
Public, cached 5 minutes. The onboarding screens in order (`sortOrder`).

Each slide: `slideId`, `layout`, `title`, `highlight`, `subtitle`, `ctaLabel`, `imageUrl`, `items`.

- `layout` tells the app which design to draw: `chef` (mascot), `menu` (6-photo category grid), `fresh` (benefit strip), or `basic` (image + text).
- `highlight` is the part of `title` drawn in the accent colour (it is always inside the title).
- `ctaLabel` is the button text (e.g. “Show me the menu”).
- `items`: for `menu` each has `title` + `imageUrl`; for `fresh` only `title` (Hot Meals, Real Ingredients, Happier You).

Images are CDN URLs; the admin manages slides in Content → Onboarding.

response.name: Three onboarding steps

exec: pm.test('slides have a layout and button', () => d.forEach((s) => { pm.expect(s.layout).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(s.ctaLabel).to.be.a('string'); }));

item.name: Step 02 · Sign in
item.description:
Release step 2. Screens: Login, OTP. Integrate after step 1.

Login sends the OTP → Verify OTP returns tokens and `isNewUser` / `profileComplete` (go to Profile setup when profileComplete is false; to Location when the user has no `currentLocation`; else Home). Send the same `x-device-id` header on every call. Access token lasts 15 min; refresh with Refresh (60-day sessions).

Demo numbers 9000000031–9000000040 never get a real SMS; locally the OTP is FIXED_OTP (123456).

request.description:
Public. Sends a 6-digit OTP to the mobile number; creates the account when the number is new.

`phoneNumber` may be typed with spaces, a leading 0 or +91 (e.g. “+91 90000 00031”); the server keeps the 10 digits. Only Indian mobile numbers (starting 6–9).

Returns `userId` (pass it to Verify OTP / Resend OTP), `otpLength`, `expiresInSec`, `resendAfterSec` (start the resend timer from this).

Errors: 422 with `errors[].field = phoneNumber` (show under the box). An email gets “Sign in with your 10-digit mobile number; email sign-in is not available”. 429 when too many tries.

response.name: OTP sent
Invalid number (422)
Email typed (422)

request.description: Public. Sends a new code for the same `userId`. Allowed once the timer from `resendAfterSec` (30 s) has run out; earlier calls get 429 “Please wait before requesting another OTP.” Returns the same fields as Login.

response.name: Too soon (429)

request.description:
Public. Header `x-device-id` is required (one stable id per install).

Returns `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, `expiresIn`, `isNewUser`, `profileComplete` and `user` (`name`, `phoneNumber`, `email`, `avatarUrl`, `points`, `tier`, `currentLocation`, …).

Where to go next:
- `profileComplete: false` → Profile setup (step 3).
- `user.currentLocation` is null → Location (step 4).
- otherwise → Home.

Errors: 400 “Invalid OTP.” (wrong code), 400 when `x-device-id` is missing, 429 after too many wrong codes.

item.name: Step 03 · Profile setup
item.description:
Release step 3. Screens: Profile setup, Edit profile (and the profile header). Integrate after step 2.

Profile setup: PATCH /users/me with the name (min 2 characters) → `profileComplete` becomes true. Photo: presign → PUT the file to `uploadUrl` → POST /users/me/avatar with `fileUrl`.

request.description:
Authenticated. Send only the fields that changed. Used by Profile setup (name, optional email) and Edit profile.

- `name`: 2–80 characters (“Please enter your full name (min 2 characters)”).
- `email`: valid email or null.
- `dob`: `YYYY-MM-DD`, not in the future.
- `gender`: `male`, `female`, `other`, `prefer_not` (the app's “Male” / “Prefer not to say” are accepted too).

Returns the full profile; `profileComplete` turns true once a real name is set. 422 errors carry `errors[].field`.

item.name: Step 04 · Location and addresses
item.description:
Release step 4. Screens: Location, Addresses, Add new address, Update address. Integrate after step 3.

Location: “Use current location” → PUT /users/me/location with the GPS point; read `data.serviceability.serviceable`. Search: autocomplete → place details. Addresses: list, add (map pin optional), edit, make default, delete. Each address returns `displayLabel` (what to print on the card) and `serviceable`.

request.description:
Authenticated. The Location search box. Call while the user types (2+ characters, debounce ~300 ms).

- `input`: the typed text.
- `latitude`/`longitude` (optional): rank places near the user first.
- `sessionToken`: a new UUID when the user starts typing; reuse it for every keystroke and for Place details, then start a new one (Google bills one session).

Returns up to 8 suggestions: `placeId`, `primaryText` (bold line), `secondaryText` (grey line), `description`. No match → empty list.

response.name: Suggestions

exec: if (d && d[0]) { pm.collectionVariables.set('placeId', d[0].placeId); try { if (pm.environment && pm.environment.name) pm.environment.set('placeId', d[0].placeId); } catch (e) {} }

request.description:
Authenticated. When the user taps a suggestion. Pass its `placeId` and the same `sessionToken`.

Returns `name`, `fullAddress`, `locality`, `city`, `state`, `pincode` (may be null for an area), `latitude`, `longitude` and `serviceability` (same as the location call).

Then save it as the current location with `PUT /users/me/location`, or pre-fill the Add new address form with these fields and coordinates. Unknown id → 404.

request.description:
Authenticated. The one call the app makes for location: send the GPS point; the backend saves it (and looks up the address text with Google Maps when GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is set) and returns data.serviceability in the same response.

Kitchen choice (all on the backend): every active kitchen whose service radius covers the point is found, nearest first. The nearest one that can take orders now (open and accepting orders) is chosen; if none can, the nearest one is chosen and isOpenNow is false. The other kitchens in range are listed in data.serviceability.alternatives (for a Switch kitchen option: send ?kitchenId= on menu calls).

The status is 200 either way; read data.serviceability.serviceable. Outside every radius: serviceable false, kitchen null, and the point is logged as demand.

Sample point 12.9568, 77.6349 lies between Indiranagar and Koramangala (both 3 km radius), so both cover it. The test script stores the chosen kitchen in {{servingKitchenId}}.

request.description:
Authenticated. The Add new address form. Required: `houseFlat`, `city`, `pincode` (6 digits). Optional: `recipientName`, `phone`, `street`, `locality`, `landmark`, `state`, `isDefault`.

- `label`: the chip — `Home`, `Office` (stored as `work`) or `Other`; any other text (e.g. “Parents' Home”) is kept as `customLabel`. The card shows `displayLabel`.
- `latitude`/`longitude`: optional. Send them when the user pinned the map; without them the server finds the address from its text, then from the pincode. If it cannot be found: 422 on `pincode` “We couldn't find this address. Check the pincode or pin it on the map.”
- The first address becomes the default.

Returns the address with `addressId`, `displayLabel`, `fullAddress`, `serviceable`, `kitchenId`, `distanceKm`. Up to 20 addresses (409 after that).

item.name: Step 05 · Home
item.description:
Release step 5. Screens: Home, About chef. Integrate after step 4.

Home is one call: GET /home returns the seasonal header, greeting, headline, search hint, “Deliver to”, delivery promise and every section in the order to draw it, plus the cart bar and the unread count. The Filters sheet uses Filters sheet options + Apply filters. How we cook opens About chef (GET /kitchen-about).

request.description:
Authenticated. The whole Home screen in one call. Optional: `veg=true` (header Veg switch), `latitude`+`longitude` (a point other than the saved location), `kitchenId`.

Top of the screen:
- `header`: seasonal theme — `header.backgroundColors` (gradient), `statusBarStyle`, text colours, and `promo` (title, subtitle, `ctaLabel`, `leftImageUrl`/`rightImageUrl`, `couponCode`, `deepLink`). Null = draw the default header.
- `greeting` (“Good afternoon, Rahul”), `headline` (“What are you craving today?”), `searchPlaceholder`.
- `deliverTo` (`label`, `line`) for the “Deliver to” pill; `serviceability` (`etaLabel`, `serviceable`, `message`).

`sections`: draw in this order, by `type`:
- `banners` (hero carousel: `eyebrow`, `title`, `highlight` = words in accent colour, `subtitle`, `imageUrl`, `ctaLabel`, `deepLink`).
- `categories` (Today's Menu tiles: `name`, `imageUrl`, `dishCount`).
- `combos` (`banner` = the MEAL COMBOS card, `items` = combos with `pricePaise`).
- `features` (3 icons: `icon`, `title`, `subtitle`).
- `usual` (Your usual?: past dishes; missing for new customers).
- `subscription_promo` (Meal Ji Plus plans: `pricePaise`, `cycleLabel`, `benefits`).
- `how_we_cook` (image card → `mealji://about-chef`).
- `popular` (dishes).

Bottom bar: `cart.itemCount` and `cart.amountToFreeDeliveryPaise` (“Shop for ₹99 more”); `unreadNotifications` for the bell; `subscription` card when the user has Meal Ji Plus.

Outside the delivery area `serviceability.serviceable` is false with a `message`, and menu sections are left out. All prices are in paise (₹1 = 100).

request.description:
Authenticated. Filters sheet → Apply filters. All parameters optional:
- `quick`: comma-separated chip values (`veg,fast,top_rated`).
- `sort`: a `value` from Filters sheet options.
- `cuisine`: one or more cuisines, comma-separated (a dish matches any of them).

Authenticated. The About chef screen for the kitchen that serves the user (or `?kitchenId=`).

- `imageUrl`: hero photo; `tagline`: tag on the photo (“FOUNDED 2024 • GREATER NOIDA”).
- `title`: small eyebrow line (“THE MAN BEHIND THE FLAME” — upper-case it in the app); `quote`; `chefName` (“— Chef Mujahid Khan”).
- `paragraphs`: the story, already split into paragraphs (`story` is the raw text).
- `standardTitle` (“The Meal Ji Standard”) and `pillars` [{ `icon`, `title`, `description` }] — `icon` is the app's icon name (fire, utensils, leaf).
- `ctaLabel` (“Taste the Menu”) and `ctaDeepLink` (`mealji://menu`).
- `gallery`: more kitchen photos; `ratingAvg`, `ratingCount`, `opensAt`, `closesAt`.

Edited by the admin in Content → About the chef.

item.description:
Release step 6. Screens: Menu, Dish detail, Combos. Integrate after step 5.

Menu → Dish detail → You may also like; Combos with chips. Every dish in a list carries `isFavorite` for the heart (step 7) and `isAvailable` / `unavailableMessage` for sold-out or out-of-hours dishes. Add to cart is step 8.

request.description:
Authenticated. The Menu tab for the kitchen that delivers to the user (or `?kitchenId=`).

- `kitchen`: `name`, `isOpenNow`, `closedReason` / `closedMessage` (show and disable Add when closed or paused), `opensAt`, `closesAt`, `nextOpenAt`.
- `categories`: the tabs, in order — `name`, `subtitle` (the tagline), `imageUrl`, `dishes`. Each dish appears once, inside its category.
- dish card fields: `dishId`, `name`, `description`, `imageUrl`, `pricePaise`, `originalPricePaise`, `isVeg`, `isBestseller`, `badge`, `ratingAvg`, `isFavorite` (heart), `isAvailable` + `unavailableMessage`.

Optional filters (same as Apply filters): `veg`, `quick`, `sort`, `cuisine`, `categoryId`, `minPricePaise`, `maxPricePaise`. A wrong value is a 422.

request.description:
Authenticated. The Dish detail screen.

- Top: `badge` (MOST POPULAR), `name`, `pricePaise`, `ratingAvg` + `ratingCount`, `preparationMinutes`, `servesCount`, `description`, `highlights` (feature badges), `isFavorite`, `isVeg`, `spicyLevel`, `calories`.
- `portions`: “Select a portion” cards — `label`, `serves` (“Serves 2”), `pricePaise` (the full price for that portion), one `isDefault`.
- `customizationGroups`: `name`, `required`, `multiple`, `minSelect`, `maxSelect`, `options` [{ `optionId`, `name`, `pricePaise` (added), `isAvailable` }].
- `mealUpgrade`: “Make it a meal” — `label`, `description` (components), `pricePaise` (added to the dish), `originalPricePaise`, `savingsPaise`, `imageUrl`. Null when the dish has none.
- `chef`: “From the chef” — `name`, `imageUrl`, `note`.
- `kitchen`: open state (as on Menu). `isAvailable` false → show `unavailableMessage` instead of Add to cart.

Price shown on Add to cart = (portion price or `pricePaise`) + chosen option prices + meal upgrade, × quantity. Unknown dish → 404.

item.description:
Release step 7. Screens: Search, Favourites (and the heart on every dish). Integrate after step 6.

Search: trending + recent when empty, results while typing (debounced), suggestions and popular dishes when nothing matches. Favourites: heart / un-heart and the saved list.

request.description:
Authenticated. `q` (1–60 characters, required). Optional `veg=true`, `latitude`+`longitude` (search the kitchen serving that point; 409 when none does), `kitchenId`.

Returns `searchId` (send it with taps), `total`, `dishCount` (“N dishes match”), `dishes` (cards with `badge`, `isVeg`, `pricePaise`, `description`, `imageUrl`, `isFavorite`), `combos`, `categories`.
Small typos still match (“briyani” → Biryani). When `total` is 0: `suggestions` (“Try these instead”) and `popular` (“Popular right now”).

item.description:
Release step 8. Screens: Cart, Checkout (Bill summary), Offers. Integrate after step 7.

The cart lives on the server: add from Dish detail / Menu / Combos, show My cart, change lines, offers, then the checkout choices (address, delivery time, tip, points, note) and the summary. Every response is the fully priced cart with ready-to-print `billLines`; the app never computes money. Paying is step 9.

request.description:
Authenticated. The Cart screen (also after app restart: the cart is kept on the server).

Every cart call returns the whole priced cart (the server does all the money):
- `kitchen` (`name`, `isOpenNow`, `message`), `etaLabel` (“28 min”), `delivery` (`type` asap | scheduled, `label`).
- `items`: `lineId`, `name`, `imageUrl`, `isVeg`, `qty`, `optionsText` (“Large • Extra Butter Jeera Rice • + Complete Meal”, or “Regular”), `unitPricePaise`, `originalUnitPricePaise`, `totalPaise`, `isAvailable` + `issue`, `priceChanged`.
- `billLines`: rows to print in order (`label`, `amountPaise`, `text` such as FREE, `strikePaise`, `isTotal`). Rows add up to the total.
- `bill` (all raw amounts), `savingsMessage` (“You're saving ₹56 on this order!”), `freeDeliveryMessage` (“Add ₹99 more for free delivery”, null when delivery is free already).
- `coupon`, `tip` (`enabled`, `presetsPaise`), `points` (`available`, `usable`, `usedPoints`), `address` (chosen or default), `paymentMethods` (`label`, `description`, `enabled`, `note`), `chefNote`.
- `canCheckout` and `blockers` [{ `code`, `message` }]: EMPTY, ITEMS_UNAVAILABLE, KITCHEN_CLOSED, MIN_ORDER, ADDRESS_REQUIRED, ADDRESS_NOT_SERVICEABLE, PICKUP_DISABLED, COD_NOT_ALLOWED, SLOT_UNAVAILABLE, COUPON_INVALID (soft: checkout still allowed).

Authenticated. Dish detail → Add to cart, a card's Add +, Combos → Add. Send `dishId` or `comboId`, `qty` (1–50), and for dishes the chosen `portionId`, `optionIds` (from `customizationGroups`), `mealUpgrade`, `specialInstructions` (≤200).

The same dish with the same choices adds to the existing line. Quick repeated taps are safe (no item is lost).
Errors: 422 when a required option is missing or a portion/option is not on the dish (`errors[].field`), 404 unknown dish/combo, 409 when the dish or combo cannot be ordered now (message says why), 409 `CART_KITCHEN_MISMATCH` when the cart holds another kitchen's food — ask the user, then send `replaceCart: true`.

Every cart call returns the whole priced cart (the server does all the money):
- `kitchen` (`name`, `isOpenNow`, `message`), `etaLabel` (“28 min”), `delivery` (`type` asap | scheduled, `label`).

- `coupon`, `tip` (`enabled`, `presetsPaise`), `points` (`available`, `usable`, `usedPoints`), `address` (chosen or default), `paymentMethods` (`label`, `description`, `enabled`, `note`), `chefNote`.

request.description: Authenticated. Checkout → Delivery Details. `options`: “As soon as possible” (`available` false when the kitchen is closed now). `scheduled`: half-hour windows today and tomorrow (`label` “Today 17:30–18:00”, `startsAt` to send as `scheduledFor`), when `scheduledEnabled` (admin: Settings → App → Schedule for later).

Authenticated. Saves the checkout choices on the cart (send only what changed):
- `addressId` (Delivery Address card; null = use the default address), `deliveryMode` (delivery | pickup).
- `scheduledFor`: a `startsAt` from Delivery slots (Schedule for later), or null for as soon as possible. Any other time → 422.
- `tipPaise` (rider tip, presets in `tip.presetsPaise`), `usePoints` (Meal Ji points), `chefNote` (Special Instructions, ≤300).

item.name: Step 09 · Place order and pay
item.description:
Release step 9. Screens: Payment (Pay ₹X), Order confirmed, Payment methods. Integrate after step 8.

Place order → (online) Razorpay checkout → Verify payment, or Payment failed → Retry payment. Cash on delivery is placed at once. Then open Order confirmed with GET /orders/{orderId} (step 10). Locally the server uses a test gateway: use “Test gateway: pay” instead of the Razorpay sheet.

request.description:
Authenticated. Places the order from the server cart with the checkout choices saved in step 8 (address, delivery time, tip, points, note). Body: `paymentMethod` (upi | card | netbanking | wallet | cod, from the cart's `paymentMethods`), optional `platform`.
Send a new `Idempotency-Key` header (a UUID) per tap on Pay: retrying with the same key returns the same order. A second Pay while one is being placed gets 409 `ORDER_IN_PROGRESS`.

Cash on delivery → `order.status` placed (or accepted), `payment` null, `amountDueOnDeliveryPaise`. Go to Order confirmed.
Online → `order.status` payment_pending and `payment`: open Razorpay checkout with `keyId`, `gatewayOrderId` (order_id), `amountPaise`, `currency`, `prefill`, `description`. Then Verify payment (success) or Payment failed (closed / declined).
`paymentError` (not null) = the payment page could not be opened; the order exists — show Retry payment.

409 with `errors[].message` = the cart blocker code (EMPTY, ITEMS_UNAVAILABLE, KITCHEN_CLOSED, ADDRESS_NOT_SERVICEABLE, SLOT_UNAVAILABLE, COUPON_INVALID…) and a message to show; 422 for an unavailable payment method.

request.description: Development only (no Razorpay keys on the server): does what the Razorpay sheet does — returns `gatewayPaymentId` and `signature` for the gateway order (and verifies it). `outcome: "failure"` simulates a declined payment. Not available in production.

response.name: Paid (test)

request.description:
Authenticated. Right after Razorpay checkout succeeds, send `razorpay_order_id` → `gatewayOrderId`, `razorpay_payment_id` → `gatewayPaymentId`, `razorpay_signature` → `signature`. The order becomes placed and the receipt is issued; then open Order confirmed with the order id.
Safe to call twice; the server also learns the result from Razorpay's webhook, so the order is confirmed even if the app closes. 400 when the signature is wrong; 404 for someone else's payment.
If the same order ends up paid twice (an old checkout finished after a retry), the extra payment is refunded automatically.

request.description:
Authenticated. Order status (“Live Kitchen”) screen; poll every 15–30 s or listen on the WebSocket (below).
`status`, `statusLabel`, `timeline` (placed → accepted → preparing → ready → out for delivery → delivered with `done` and `at`), `kitchenSteps` (the kitchen's own steps, e.g. Marinating → Charring in the tandoor → Plating & packing, with `state` and `at`), `currentActivity` (“Right now: Charring the chicken.”), `etaMinutes`, `arrivingByLabel` (“Arriving by 9:25 PM • 14 min”), `rider`, `canCancel` and `cancelReasons`.

WebSocket `wss://<host>/ws?token=<accessToken>`: send `{"type":"track:subscribe","data":{"orderId":"…"}}`; receive `order:status`, `order:kitchen_step`, `track:status` (status text), `order:rider_assigned`, `track:location` ({ lat, lng, heading, speed, updatedAt }). Send `track:unsubscribe` when leaving.

item.name: Home header themes
item.description: Seasonal look of the app's home header: background gradient or image, status bar, and the promo card with an image on each side. The default theme shows unless a dated theme is live; the highest priority wins when windows overlap. The app reads the live theme as `header` in GET /api/v1/home. Seeded: Meal Ji Indigo (default), Halloween: Spooky Bites (live from the seed date to 1 Nov), Diwali: Festival of Lights (3–13 Nov). Sign in as a staff account with content.manage (demo super admin 9000000001).

item.name: Settings

request.description: Requires settings.read. Every setting group with its fields, types, limits, defaults and the permission needed to edit it.

Requires settings.read. Optional scopeType (global | city | kitchen) and scopeId (city name or kitchen ID). Returns stored values at that scope, effective values with inheritance, the source of each value, scheduled versions and history.

Requires settings.read plus the group's permission (settings.app / settings.policies). `values` is a patch: only the listed fields change; null removes an override. A reason is required when a money field changes. Optional effectiveFrom (ISO, future) schedules the change; scheduled changes are independent, so a later immediate change never brings a scheduled one forward.
Requires settings.read plus the group's permission. Cancels one version that has not taken effect yet; other scheduled versions stay as they are. 409 if it is already in effect.
